items.title: INFESTED CITIES
items.text:
INFESTED CITIES
If you have not already done so, open F 14

Use these stickers to mark infested cities.
(If you run out of stickers, no new cities will become infested.)

mechanics.effect: Open doors F and 14 if they are still sealed. Use the rat stickers to mark infested cities. When the stickers run out, no new city becomes infested.
restrictions: No new city becomes infested after the stickers run out
mechanics.stickerArt: Green circle with a lighter green rat silhouette.

summary: Infested-cities sheet and a bag of 21 identical green rat stickers. The card says INFESTED CITIES, tells you to open F and 14 if you have not, and says to mark infested cities with the stickers. If the stickers run out, no new city becomes infested. The sheet shows 3 rows of 7 rats. Corner badge is 50. The bag name in the manifest is Infected City Stickers.
